objective.intro: To test all tasks planned for the Sprint and validate that the application correctly supports main business flows and processes such as:

environment.note: Web related testing was performed on viewports from 1024px to 2560px wide.

testDesign.name: Payment Sandbox Testing
testDesign.goal: Verify every payment flow against the provider's sandbox before any real card is involved.
process: Execute each payment method with the provider's test cards, covering approved, declined and 3-D Secure paths;
Verify the order state after every outcome, including abandoned and timed-out sessions.
completion: All planned payment paths have been executed;
Every mismatch between charge and order state has been reported.
